findings.issue: Refresh token not rotated on use — allows replay attacks
findings.evidence: Line 142 returns existingRefreshToken instead of generating a new one after validation
findings.recommendation: Generate a new refresh token, persist it, and invalidate the old one before returning

findings.issue: Token validation error message leaks internal details
findings.evidence: Error response includes the decoded token payload in development mode
findings.recommendation: Return a generic 401 message; log details server-side only
